letter.label: Quest available
letter.text:
A Free Droid runner came in at dusk with a request it had plainly been made to learn word for word. The animals that range out past the old works have gone wrong, the way things go wrong near the breached vaults, and the enclaves want them put down before the rot in them spreads.

The runner would not say who asked the enclaves. It did not wait for an answer.

Accept, and the pack will come to you. Kill every one of them.

letter.label: A gravcore in the sand
letter.text:
The perimeter lights caught it an hour before dawn: a gravcore, whole and faintly warm, set upright in the sand just outside the ship's shadow. It is older than anything in your stores, and it fits the Utinni's sockets as if it had been cut for them.

The sky has been empty of Imperial traffic for days.
